title: Exterior photograph of a multi-storey glass-fronted office building with vertical banner
objects_and_counts: One large multi-storey building with a continuous grid of rectangular windows occupies the central and upper portions of the image; the building shows recessed or projecting rectangular bay sections in several places on the façade.

One tall vertical glazed stair/atrium tower is visible at the building's left end (image left); a second glazed vertical tower with a large vertical banner is visible at the building's right end (image right).

At least three road vehicles are visible in the lower part of the image: one white van near the left foreground, one white car closer to center-right foreground, and a darker vehicle partially visible behind trees near center; the count is a visible minimum of three vehicles.
A metal chain-link fence with a top rail runs across the immediate foreground; it is cropped at the bottom edge of the image.
A row of at least six trees is visible between the building and the road; some tree crowns are partially cropped or overlap each other.
Street furniture and poles are visible near the road in front of the trees (streetlight poles and traffic signage), but specific counts of these items cannot be reliably determined from the image.
No clearly identifiable people are visible in the scene at a scale that allows reliable counting; if any pedestrians exist they are too small or obscured by trees/vehicles to count.
